title: Consolidated multi-entity compliance report
description: Single compliance report spanning all subsidiaries with entity-level drill-down. Currently requires generating N reports and manually merging in Excel.
business_justification: Audit prep takes 1 full day per entity. With 12 subsidiaries that is 12 days of legal ops time per quarter.

title: Scheduled compliance report auto-delivery
description: Auto-generate and deliver compliance reports on a configurable schedule (e.g. 5 business days before quarter-end) with email delivery to designated reviewers.
business_justification: Manual triggering causes missed deadlines. One missed Q3 report required emergency rescheduling of auditor.

title: Lease-specific clause library expansion
description: Expand AI extraction to cover lease-specific clauses: CPI/escalation caps, co-tenancy clauses, ROFO/ROFR, percentage rent, CAM reconciliation, tenant improvement allowance.
business_justification: Current miss rate on these clauses is causing manual re-review of entire documents, eliminating time savings.

title: Explainable AI scores with factor breakdown
description: Show the top 3 factors driving any AI-generated score (risk score, renewal probability, confidence score) with the specific clause or data point behind each factor.
business_justification: Attorneys won't act on black-box scores. Scores are being ignored, reducing product value to near zero for this use case.

title: GASB 87 compliance report template
description: Add GASB 87 as a supported accounting standard alongside IFRS 16 and ASC 842, for government entity clients.
business_justification: Two enterprise prospects are government entities. Deal is blocked without GASB 87 support. Estimated $240K ARR at risk.

title: Batch lease portfolio review
description: Upload multiple leases at once and receive a portfolio-level summary: escalation risks ranked, renewal dates, unusual clause flags, outliers vs. standard terms.
business_justification: Portfolio acquisitions involve 20+ leases at once. Current one-at-a-time flow makes acquisition due diligence impractical.

title: Lease type filtering in analytics dashboard
description: Filter all dashboard metrics by lease type (real estate vs. equipment vs. vehicle). Currently all lease types are mixed in a single view.
business_justification: CFO requires separate reporting for real estate and equipment. Legal ops manually splits data monthly — estimated 4 hours/month.

title: Pre-submission data validation check
description: Before a compliance report can be submitted/exported, run an automated validation: check for stale data, missing required fields, period consistency, and flag issues for review.
business_justification: One submitted report contained prior-period data for 8 leases. Required refiling. Auditor trust was damaged.

title: Legacy contract language support
description: Train extraction models on pre-2015 lease language: 'Act of God' for force majeure, 'assignment covenant' for subletting restriction, 'additional rent' for CAM charges.
business_justification: 35% of enterprise portfolio uses legacy language. These leases are highest-risk but least covered by AI.

title: Webhook-based ERP sync (replace polling)
description: Replace hourly API polling with webhook push notifications so ERP systems receive lease updates in real time without hitting rate limits.
business_justification: API rate limits cause partial syncs during quarter-end — highest-volume period. Causes manual reconciliation that defeats integration value.

title: Executive one-page portfolio summary
description: Auto-generated one-page PDF: total lease liability, top 5 risks, upcoming expirations (90 days), compliance status. Formatted for board/exec presentation.
business_justification: GC spends 3 hours manually creating this summary for every board meeting. Should be generated in one click.

title: Confidence score context and threshold alerts
description: Show which specific clause text created extraction uncertainty. Alert when confidence falls below a configurable threshold so attorneys know when to re-read.
business_justification: Currently attorneys either over-trust or ignore confidence scores. Neither behavior is correct. Need calibrated trust.

title: Trend analytics: time-series metrics
description: Add trend lines to dashboard metrics (volume, turnaround time, risk score over time). Current dashboard is snapshots only — cannot show improvement or regression over quarters.
business_justification: GC asks 'are we getting better?' every quarter. Today that requires manual Excel charting from data exports.

title: Variance bridge in compliance reports
description: When lease liability changes between reporting periods, show a waterfall breakdown: new leases added, leases terminated, lease modifications, FX impact, interest accretion.
business_justification: Auditors always ask for variance explanation. Currently requires a manual bridge built in Excel after generating the report.

title: Redline collaboration with external counsel
description: Allow external counsel (guest access) to view AI redline suggestions and leave comments, without full LegalGraph access. Track all external suggestions in audit log.
business_justification: Negotiation with counterparty involves outside counsel. Currently screen-share or email redlines, losing version history and audit trail.
